svg.text: Kinematic review | Standard DH to the configured TCP
Pose: q1 ... q6 = 0 rad; jaws open. Orthographic side view; dimensions in mm.
a1 Base height a2 Shoulder offset a3 Upper arm a4 Elbow offset
a5 Forearm axis distance a6 J6-to-TCP axial reach a7 TCP lateral offset
q = model joint angles (rad). a = link length along X; d = link offset along Z.
MSG jaw variants share this operational TCP; it is not a measured grasp center.
The 28.35 mm lateral TCP offset is included in DH row 6 as a = -a7.
Independent FK checks: 128 poses, including zero and joint-limit bounds.
Max URDF vs MuJoCo TCP: 0.001000 mm / 0.000479 deg
Max ideal DH vs URDF: 0.002787 mm / 0.000679 deg
Right-angle DH approximates rounded export rotations. The snapshot uses the MuJoCo visual meshes.
Source: parol6_msg.urdf + scene_msg.xml | Full transforms, hashes and checks: msg.json
All sheets use the same scale. Side projection: +X points left, +Z up; view from +Y.
Source Robotics / robot_descriptions / Generated from current models; physical-data assumptions: DYNAMICS.md.
